note: History of edalint.protocol.code_hash() (sha256 over src/edalint/**/*.py). Freeze records are NOT rewritten when the hash moves: each one certifies the code that produced the results registered under it. A freeze whose code_hash is not the current hash simply no longer unlocks test reads; a new test read needs a new freeze. Nothing in the guards reads this file; tests/test_code_hash_lineage.py pins it.
